about: GreedFall: The Dying World is a narrative-driven RPG. The story takes you to the far reaches of a vast fantasy world, inspired by 17th century Europe. Create your character: appearance, attributes, talents, abilities.
Then dive into a rich adventure, meeting many allies who will prove vital in overcoming the dangers that await you.
As you progress, every choice you make influences the course of events, every alliance you forge has real consequences, and every decision can change the fate of the world.
Force is far from your only option in successfully overcoming the traps and challenges you encounter along the way.
Use diplomacy to persuade your opponents, craft your own equipment, find hidden treasures, and access forbidden places with cunning tricks and disguises.
summary: Explore the world of GreedFall in a thrilling new adventure.
